title: Beginning Wheel Thrown Pottery with Len Cockman
pay_text: Online, in person, or by phone
summary: Eight-week wheel-throwing class ending with a raku firing on the final session. Students bring bisque-fired forms for glazing and participate in the raku kiln firing.
how_to_join: Register online, in person at 574-282-2787, or by phone; download PDF form for in-person or phone registration
bring: bisque-fired forms for glazing and firing
source_quote: Beginning Wheel Thrown Pottery with Len Cockman September 14 @ 6:30 pm - November 2 @ 8:30 pm
evidence_sentence: The class culminates with raku firing on session 8, where students glaze functional pieces and participate in the raku kiln firing.
evidence_quote: During Session 8, we will get the raku kiln firing, and while that kiln temperature is rising to the proper level, we will glaze the last of the functional pieces.
